name: Global Time Ghost
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
Tired of timezone confusion killing conversions? Global Time Ghost is the lightweight WordPress timezone converter that makes your site visitor-smart. Convert UTC times to local time seamlessly—ideal for e-commerce, events, and remote teams.

Free Features:
* [gtg_time] shortcode: Display local times in posts, pages, or widgets (with upgrade badge).
* WooCommerce integration: Add local-time badges to product prices.
* Basic settings page: Enable/disable features easily.
* Browser-based detection: Uses JS and cookies for accurate timezone conversion (falls back to UTC).

Pro Features (upgrade for $39 lifetime):
* Full auto-adjustments for prices, events, and email reminders.
* Deep hooks for The Events Calendar, WooCommerce, and more.

No bloat—just PHP smarts for better global UX. Perfect for WooCommerce stores, event sites, and international blogs needing a reliable local time plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/global-time-ghost.
  2. Activate via WordPress admin.
  3. Drop [gtg_time] in any content—see it adapt to local time!
sections.faq:
How does timezone detection work?

It uses the browser’s Intl API for precise local time detection, stores via cookie, and validates against PHP’s timezone list.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! Free version adds timezone badges to prices; pro enables dynamic adjustments.

Is it compatible with event plugins like The Events Calendar?

Free: Use the shortcode. Pro: Auto-hooks for event timezone conversion.
